name: Remix
seo_title: Hire Senior Remix Developers | Fast, Resilient Web Experiences
meta_description: Build fast, resilient web experiences. Hire senior Remix experts vetted for progressive enhancement, loaders/actions, and route-driven UX.
intro: Remix shines when you embrace the platform: forms, HTTP, and progressive enhancement. We look for engineers who design resilient UX that work with or without JS.

pains.pain: Forms that fail without client JS?
pains.problem: SPA habits break progressive enhancement and resilience.
pains.solution: We lean on HTML forms, server actions, and route loaders for robust UX.

pains.problem: Poor route boundaries and data waterfalls delay content.
pains.solution: We split routes, use loaders to prefetch, and stream above-the-fold content.

pains.problem: Global state where route state would do increases complexity.
pains.solution: We prefer route-based state and fetchers with clear lifecycles.

technical_analysis: We require loader/action-centric designs, resilient error boundaries, and measurable navigation perf gains. Candidates demonstrate platform-first thinking over client-JS crutches.
